<command>
make check
</command>

No file edits come before this. I'd stop here until I see the output, because everything after depends on it.

Before I offer merge/PR options, I'm running `make check` (`pytest --golden tests/` + `ruff check .`) on `feat/height-rounding`. I'll report the result next.

- **`make check` passes:** I continue to Step 1b (deferred backlog stats), then Step 2 (environment detection), Step 3 (base branch) and Step 4 (the 4-option menu). Codex review (Step 4b) and any aged-tail question come only if you pick merge or PR.
